xmet:0000650.definition: Loss of a hydroxyl group. Antonym of hydroxylation.

xmet:0000660.definition: Introduction of halogen. Antonym of dehalogenation.

xmet:0000661.definition: Introduction of an amino group. Antonym of deamination.

xmet:0000670.definition: Introduction of a formyl group (often N-formylation).

xmet:0000671.definition: Loss of a formyl group. Antonym of formylation.

xmet:0000680.definition: Formation of an N-nitroso species (reactive-metabolite relevant).

xmet:0000690.definition: Removal/replacement of sulfur (e.g. phosphorothioate oxidative desulfuration).

xmet:0000691.definition: Introduction of sulfur. Antonym of desulfuration (not synonymous with sulfation).

xmet:0000700.definition: Hydrolytic removal of a glucuronide. Antonym of glucuronidation.

xmet:0000701.definition: Hydrolytic removal of a sulfate. Antonym of sulfation.

xmet:0000702.definition: Cleavage of a glycoside. Antonym of glycosylation.

xmet:0000703.definition: Removal of a glutathione adduct. Antonym of glutathionation.

xmet:0000704.definition: Removal of a cysteine conjugate. Antonym of cysteine conjugation.

xmet:0000720.definition: Cleavage removing an aryl group from N/O/S (related to dealkylation).

xmet:0000721.definition: Hydroxylation at a carbon alpha to a carbonyl or heteroatom.

xmet:1600200.definition: Site on an alicyclic (saturated ring) carbon.

xmet:1600201.definition: Aromatic carbon on a fused benzene ring system.

xmet:0000681.definition: Removal of an N-nitroso group. Antonym of N-nitrosation.

xmet:0000217.definition: Oxidative removal of an S-methyl group.

xmet:0000730.definition: Addition of an aryl group. Antonym of dearylation.

xmet:0000731.definition: Introduction of a carbonyl via carbonylation (distinct from carboxylation). Antonym of decarbonylation.

xmet:0000732.definition: Generic removal of a phase II conjugate (umbrella over deglucuronidation, desulfation, …).

xmet:1400200.definition: Medchem structural alert / toxicophore motif associated with bioactivation or reactive-metabolite risk. Orthogonal to site_type (where the edit occurs) and soft-spot liability (metabolic vulnerability). Seed set; expand later.

xmet:1400201.definition: Furan ring as a structural alert for oxidative bioactivation.

xmet:1400202.definition: Thiophene ring as a structural alert for S-oxidation / bioactivation.

xmet:1400203.definition: Terminal or internal alkyne / triple bond as a structural alert.

xmet:1600210.definition: Alkyne / carbon–carbon triple bond site environment.
